reading.thesis: Standardize the observable state-transition-dependent data-transfer boundary between independently governed systems, not participating runtimes.
reading.manifest: Declares intent and binds source, destination, payload commitment, applicable predecessor/state context and requested capability; it is communication provenance, not payload authority.
reading.disposition: Every attempted transition-dependent communication terminates ALLOW, DENY or FAIL_CLOSED; transport success is not ALLOW.
reading.runtime_independence: Each framework retains its own runtime, governance implementation, state representation, database, credentials and internal authority.

implementation.action: Observe current PR/head/workflows and repair only demonstrated defects.
Complete canonical protocol envelope and receipt constraints.
Validate ALLOW, DENY, FAIL_CLOSED and negative binding mutations.
Classify actual SDK/Interlock/InTr seams as LOCAL_PROCESS, NETWORK_NON_ECOSYSTEM, INTERLOCK_INTR, or UNKNOWN_NOT_AUTHENTICALLY_OBSERVED.
Expose local versus ecosystem capability while preserving SDK as caller/client.
Exercise manifested checkpoint egress and witness-return ingress without moving checkpoint authority from Master Records.
Map external protocols only from exact counterpart specifications and independently retained evidence.
